integrity: Universal proof is self-contained in RESULT.md; standalone finite verification is supportive rather than an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Proved for integers r>=2 and n>=2r+1 and only the first r+1 image-rank thresholds; later thresholds and n<=2r are not determined. Independent validation has not been performed.
